name: PAC.BIOSCI.OF CAL.DL-,001
summary: Pacific Biosciences of California (PacBio) is a biotechnology company that designs, develops, and manufactures advanced sequencing systems. The company's Single Molecule, Real-Time (SMRT) technology enables long-read sequencing, which is used for various applications in genomics research, drug discovery, and diagnostics. PacBio is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.
